snippet.textDisplay: Tbh even I can admit Kentucky had no business beating lsu. They won a horrible officiated game. You had a false start on 2 point and despite a timeout not even being called before the false start they still gave em the time out, plus multiple blocks in backs on a Kentucky punt return and the tush push touchdown that should’ve been stopped but they just kept letting players push him even tho the play was clearly dead and the refs even admitted it saying “if they woulda called it dead they wouldn’t have made it out the stadium” and I know a lot of this because of someone im still close with works with the lsu program and was at that game and for him to even mention all that to me I knew he wasn’t lying and watching the replay of the game made me realize just how bad it was. This is what I hate about ball today man you see it over and over just like the W Michigan vs Michigan,Miami vs fsu,byu vs ucf,Kentucky vs lsu, ND vs byu and on and on. You see it week after week and all you get is some letter saying how they didn’t follow protocol and literally nothing gets done about it meanwhile a team just had the season ruined over crappy refs. It really is sad man there is no integrity left in the game. But to your point even I can admit LSU definitely should be a 7-2 team rn with a win over Kentucky. Just like alot of other teams should have a extra win and literally got screwed by refs not following protocol and everyone just goes along with it man that just blows my mind, i understand having a bad call here and there but this has been every week letters coming out on refs not following protocol and nothing gets done man sometimes a game will come down to that 1 play but it doesn’t mean that team deserves to lose over people literally not doing they job. I’m just saying. And it’s clear college committee doesn’t care about the fans at all man everyone votes to not have a expanded playoff an they basically tell us they don’t care and week after week horrible officiated games costing teams season and they send out a “sorry” letter that fixes absolutely nothing because they just don’t care man they don’t care about the fans or the players or the programs. Just like they said reducing game time would help with health issues only to get a million more ads/commercials shoved down your throat every 3 minutes and the games last just as long an they just make more money off commercials man it’s all about the money and they absolutely do not care about anything else and it’s ridiculous. But as long as it doesn’t happen to your team people just go along with it and that’s part the problem man people need to stand up for this type bs, I know I’m sick of seeing games decided by refs.
